response.original_title: [Instant-Guide] How to Add a Guest to Your Swan Hellenic Cruise Booking
response.overview: You can add a guest to your reservation by calling Swan Hellenic Customer Service at +1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK), as changes cannot be made online. Important Requirements Cabin Capacity: Your current stateroom must have space +1-866-254-7549 (like a sofa bed or extra berth) for another person. Ship Limits: Additions depend on total ship occupancy and lifeboat safety rules +1-866-254-7549. Re-pricing: Adding a traveler usually updates the cost of your booking to current fare rates, taxes, and port fees +1-866-254-7549.Steps to Add a Guest Check your room: Review your current booking +1-866-254-7549 and occupancy rules. Call support: Contact Swan Hellenic or your travel agent +1-866-254-7549. Share details: Provide the new guest's full legal name, date of birth, passport info, and loyalty numbers +1-866-254-7549.Review fees: Ask for a full breakdown of any added costs. Get confirmation: Receive your updated booking confirmation,
